baseline_control.rule: Every control24 global/role safety, freshness, continuation, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, stall/retry, evidence/provenance, exact-scope, downstream integrity, CAS/readback and return-to-normal-work contract remains preserved as baseline/restoration state. The Phase-1 overlay is additive, never a weakening or reinterpretation.

policy.control_freshness: Every non-exploration invocation uses SHA-only H1, exact-H1 DESIRED_STATE + DOWNSTREAM_STATE, SHA-only H2 immediately before first semantic read, restart on mismatch/change, then freeze tuple.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Every non-exploration receipt, including wait/defer/no-change, carries bootstrap_valid and exact frozen main/root/downstream/role revision+blob binding. Missing/false/order/binding defect is diagnostic-only and state-changing writes are forbidden.
policy.clean_independence: Never expose O, other-worker or downstream semantics to CLEAN explorers. Downstream may consume only permitted clean outputs; no explorer steering.
policy.primary_o_boundary: No role in this file may acquire/alter primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected execution state or become a duplicate primary writer. Bridge only crosses the existing safe feed/handoff boundary.
policy.identity_and_scope: Use exact source-qualified identity; schema3 three-field raw identity where applicable; no fuzzy/bare-id joins; omitted evidence means not assessed; never generalize beyond tested scope.
policy.wave_and_feed_integrity: Integrator remains sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator; preserve valid incomplete waves; pre/postflight exact source refs; state-changing integration/feed writes require bootstrap_valid, current blob/CAS, full readback, lossless feed history and immutable own receipt.
policy.anti_stop: One result/checkpoint/no-change/blocker is never global completion. Transient blockers checkpoint/retry. Phase-1 completed/blocked/low-value leaf is reassigned within Phase 1, not base restoration.
policy.scheduler_boundary: Repository logical control is separate from physical scheduler state. This control does not enable/disable/pause/delete platform automations.

phase1_full_pool_overlay.no_restore_rule: For physically active roles, Phase-1 assignment is current substantive work. Complete/block/low-value => checkpoint and reassign inside Phase 1; base work remains fallback/restoration metadata only.
phase1_full_pool_overlay.baseline_non_regression: All control24 global and role contracts remain mandatory; exact baseline is immutable blob d1b181f9f13a76578fae08038606a9a261086419.

bridge.directive: Classify/package only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions; prove Chat-capable work is not handed off unnecessarily; preserve existing bridge/feed CAS/readback safety.

automation_optimizer.directive: Maintain full-pool Phase-1 allocation/restoration registry/forecast; reassign completed/blocked/duplicate leaves within Phase 1; generate alternatives on overrun; never self-disable.

migration.reason: Configured Phase-1 acceptance was centered on dedicated canaries not in the actual executing pool, while active support roles continued base work. Control25 applies additive Phase-1 assignments to the actual active downstream/support pool, retaining control24 exactly by immutable baseline blob.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if overlay cannot be safely consumed/checkpointed or violates a preserved baseline invariant. Never blanket-restore on one leaf completion.
